title: Evaluation comparison for categorical Cech complexes
statement: Let X be a topological space, I an index type, R a ring, U:I→Opens(X) any family, P an R-module presheaf, and V an open. Evaluating the categorical Cech complex of the presheaf W↦(Z↦P(W∩Z)) on V and forgetting scalars gives a complex isomorphic to the explicit abelian-group Cech complex of the family i↦U_i∩V with coefficients in the underlying abelian-group presheaf of P. No covering or acyclicity is assumed.

source.place: Proof paragraph 1, evaluation in Cech coordinates

proof.text: In degree n the categorical product is indexed by Fin(n+1) tuples. Evaluation and forgetting scalars preserve the product, yielding a family of sections P((product_l U(y_l))∩V). In the category of opens the product is the intersection; since Fin(n+1) is nonempty this open equals intersection_l(U(y_l)∩V). The product universal property identifies its sections with the dependent-function cochains. Under these isomorphisms every coface deletes its index and restricts along the same inclusion; their alternating sums agree. The isomorphisms therefore form a cochain-complex isomorphism. Empty opens and empty index types satisfy the same product construction. The Lean proof first forms a degreewise PreservesProduct.iso for evaluation, checks its differential compatibility with cechComplexFunctor_d_π, applies the existing proved cechComplexFunctorIso, and then uses degreewise additive equivalences induced by the two inclusions between the equal intersections. The restriction-composition lemma map_map_apply proves compatibility with the differential.

theorem cech_evaluation_comparison
    {X : TopCat.{u}} {ι : Type u} {R : Type u} [Ring R]
    (U : ι → Opens X) (P : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} R) (V : Opens X) :
    Nonempty
      ((((evaluation (Opens X)ᵒᵖ (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj (op V) ⋙
            forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
        ((CategoryTheory.cechComplexFunctor U).obj
          ((prod.functor (C := Opens X)).op ⋙ Functor.opHom _ _ ⋙
            (Functor.whiskeringRight _ _ _).obj P)) ≅
        (cechComplex (fun i ↦ U i ⊓ V)).obj
          (P ⋙ forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat))
